note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 100; the original states that no specimen of this subspecies was available and transcribes the original description by Silvestri (1923) directly; that description is in English and is very brief. The alate is not described. The few measurements of the queen and the worker are too brief and are combined under “Other”. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head length 1.70 mm, width 1.08 mm, mandible length 0.78 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 about one third longer than segment 3, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen body length 6 mm, head length 0.96 mm, head width between the eyes 0.90 mm, antennal length 1.72 mm, hind tibia length 1.18 mm; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 twice the length of segment 3, segments 3 and 4 subequal. Worker head width 0.84 mm.
